about: [O6b critic] the havoc, good hands (my own bot): a long run-up down the lane under the el and a diagonal into the door of three east sedans at speed, twice each; then out and a look at one from the pavement.

steps.eval: (() => { const c=G.city.car; return JSON.stringify({v:c.speed, st:c.smashD.state, dmg:c.damage}); })()

(() => { const S = G.stage.smash; const P = S.out.filter((i) => i.part); const k = {}; let live = 0; for (const it of P) { k[it.kind] = (k[it.kind]||0)+1; if (it.state==='live') live++; } return JSON.stringify({ parts: k, live, cars: G.city.cars.map((c,i)=>[i, +c.damage.toFixed(2), c.smashD&&c.smashD.state]), me:[G.controller.pos.x,G.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)), inCar:G.city.inCar }); })()
